payload.reason: One proposal, selected as the core. Three of its seams fail rules that are in the tree today, so they were redesigned: the store read moved out of TopLevelSnapshot.cs, the row copy moved into the tracker, and T-012 is left as it is. Four forks are left for a person.
payload.selection_rationale: Only one proposal (practice) was offered, and it is taken as the core because it matches how the code is already shaped. ScanStore.Unfinished, AtLeast and NotListed already give the right answer for each entry (read at ScanStore.cs:201-269). FolderTreeNode already routes every figure through one HasFigures gate. The stopped list already draws its rows through TopLevelRowText. The approach is the simplest that works: one predicate per drawn row, a cached lazy read, one field on the row set once at the ending, one word constant, and two column widths. The proposal's over_engineering_flag is honoured: there is no view-model layer, no re-ranking by the bound and no live recomputation. Checked against the tree, three of its pieces fail as written. (1) TopLevelSnapshot.WithAtLeast(ScanStore) and a `ScanStore.AtLeastFigures?` field put the type name ScanStore into src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevelSnapshot.cs, which the fitness rule 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends' forbids: that file is not on its allow-list (fitness.yaml:564-586). (2) Copying a row means restating Revised, and 'only the tracker sets a top-level row's Revised flag' (`\bRevised\s*=(?![=>])`, fitness.yaml:850-859) fires on any such line outside TopLevelTracker.cs. (3) Extending T-012 changes an existing case. Its stated reason, that a second 100k case would not fit the 120 s limit, does not hold: the limit applies to each command (Q-222), and T-012 ran both halves in 81 s. The redesign: the read and the copy live in TopLevelTracker.cs as an internal static, which may both name ScanStore and set Revised. The public way in is ScanResult.StoppedTopLevel(); ScanResult.cs is on the allow-list. The row field becomes a new Core value type, TopLevelAtLeast. Criterion 5 gets a new T-014, and T-012 stays byte-for-byte. Two other parts of the proposal were trimmed. The headers stay in MainWindow, with one 'at least' clause appended to the tree header and its lead unchanged; there is no separate size-check arm. The clipping check now measures the widest prefixed figure directly. The proposal relied on the fixture's own figures to catch a revert to 80 DIP, but after a Stop in the listing every lower bound is 0, so the fixture never produces 'at least 1,000 bytes'. What the spike measured stands: 102 DIP is required ('at least 1,000 bytes' needs 101.26 DIP, and clips at 80).

components.name: Tree row at-least figures
components.responsibility: SizeText and OnDiskText draw TopLevelRowText.AtLeastSize(bound.Size / bound.OnDisk) when the row's entry is unfinished, and draw today's FigureText.FormatSize(Size / OnDisk) otherwise. The bound comes from a private cached Bound property: on its first read under HasFigures it reads `store.Unfinished(_entry) ? store.AtLeast(_entry) : null` once and keeps the result, because both texts need it and a high row's AtLeast scans its whole pending run. Every figure text still goes through HasFigures, so a not-listed row keeps drawing no figure and no mark (SL-110, lesson #508). Unchanged: OnDisk (the ranking value), Share, BarWidth, ShareShown, Note, EnsureChildren and Root. That leaves the measured 100k open path free of any per-child read (lesson #170); only the realized rows read the store.
components.key_interactions: Reads ScanStore.Unfinished and ScanStore.AtLeast through FolderTreeSession.Store, which is the returned store, so the reads are on the post-return terms lesson #522 requires. The store is null once the session closes, and the texts then read empty. FolderTree*.cs is the App's one exception to 'the window never touches the scan store'.

components.name: The at-least word and the stopped list's figures line
components.responsibility: Adds `internal const string AtLeastWord = "at least"` and `internal static string AtLeastSize(long bytes) => $"{AtLeastWord} {FormatSize(bytes)}"` beside NotReadYet. AtLeastSize is the only place a figure gets the word. FiguresOf gains one arm, `row.AtLeast is { } a`, in which every number on the line carries the word: size (a.Bytes), on disk (a.OnDisk), files (a.Files), folders (row.Folders - 1) and the could-not-be-read count. Rows with no AtLeast, NotRead rows included, keep today's exact text: Q-276 is open on what a NotRead row's line should say, and its title '(not read yet)' is its mark. TitleOf is unchanged.
components.key_interactions: Core.Tests compiles it as linked source (FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj:55), so its words are tested on rows a real stopped scan built. MainWindow's headers build their clause from AtLeastWord. FolderTreeNode calls AtLeastSize. The hook calls FiguresOf by reflection.

components.name: The row's lower bound and the snapshot copy
components.responsibility: Adds `public readonly record struct TopLevelAtLeast(long Bytes, long OnDisk, long Files)` and `public TopLevelAtLeast? AtLeast { get; init; }` on TopLevelRow. AtLeast is null on every snapshot the scanner publishes, and set only by the post-scan read. Adds `internal TopLevelSnapshot WithRows(TopLevelRow[] rows)`, a private copy constructor that keeps Root, Sequence, Final, Completed, the four totals and StoppedInSizeChecks. Nothing in this file names ScanStore or sets Revised. Bytes and OnDisk stay the listing figures, so the list's LargestFirst order and the Revised meaning are untouched.
components.key_interactions: Passes 'published snapshot types cannot be changed after they are built': init, not set; the record struct starts `public readonly`; the property has a body. Read by TopLevelRowText (pattern match, no store type named) and by the hook through reflection.

components.name: The post-scan marking read
components.responsibility: `internal static TopLevelSnapshot WithAtLeast(TopLevelSnapshot final, ScanStore store)` in TopLevelTracker, with the public way in `public TopLevelSnapshot? StoppedTopLevel()` on ScanResult. StoppedTopLevel returns TopLevel unchanged, with no store read, when Status is not Cancelled, TopLevel is null, TopLevel is not Final or is Completed, or Store.Count is 0. Otherwise it calls WithAtLeast. WithAtLeast maps row i to entry store.FirstChild(0)+i, the tracker's own seeding (TopLevelTracker.cs:38, 53-55), and throws InvalidOperationException if Rows.Count != store.ChildCount(0). For each row whose entry is `Unfinished && !NotListed`, it rebuilds the row as `new TopLevelRow(name, path, kind, state, bytes, onDisk, files, folders, unreadableBelow) { Revised = r.Revised, FailedKind = r.FailedKind, AtLeast = new(a.Size, a.OnDisk, a.Files) }`. That line is legal only in this file. It returns final.WithRows(rows) when any row was marked, and final itself when none was.
components.key_interactions: ScanResult.cs (src/FsAnalyser.Core/Scanning/ScanResult.cs) and TopLevelTracker.cs are both on the allow-list for 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends'. The static touches no tracker instance state, so 'the tracker is owned by the scanner thread' still holds. It is called on the UI thread with a returned result's own store.

components.name: Ending wiring and stopped headers
components.responsibility: Line 301 passes `result?.StoppedTopLevel()` where it passes `result?.TopLevel` today (same guard: no failure, not Completed). The marked snapshot is a new object, so ShowFinalTopLevel draws it even when a tick already showed the unmarked final one (fact 6), and the SL-100 restore by Path keeps the selection and focus. Only the size clause of ListHeader's two stopped arms is reworded. Listing Stop: 'What was read before the stop. Rows marked {NotReadYet} or stopped partway leave out what the scan did not reach. Figures marked {AtLeastWord} are all that is certain until each file's own size is read; a row with no mark is final.' Size-check Stop: 'What was read before the stop. Every folder was listed, but not every file's own size was read: figures marked {AtLeastWord} are all that is certain, and a row with no mark is final.' StoppedTreeHeader keeps its lead ('Not read yet: folders the stop came before.') and appends 'Figures marked {AtLeastWord} are all that is certain; a figure with no mark is final. Largest first, by space on disk as listed, of what was read in {root}'. The running and completed headers are unchanged. Exact punctuation is the builder's to settle, but each clause must stay.
components.key_interactions: Uses result.Store only indirectly, through ScanResult, which the App store rule allows. Words come from TopLevelRowText constants, never from literals, so 'the unread word is written once' stays quiet. OffersStoppedTree already keeps the tree off a Count-0 store.

components.name: Wider figure columns
components.responsibility: The tree's Size and On disk headings (MainWindow.xaml:421-422) and cells (:472, :474) go from Width 80 to 102, the spike's prerequisite. The Name column gives up about 44 DIP. The list's figure line needs no change: the spike measured it fitting with 399.5 DIP to spare.

components.name: Hook: the store's answers and the drawn layout beside every row
components.responsibility: New NoInlining readers in StoppedTree.cs, built like NotListedOf: each resolves LastResult.Store on every call and reads the row's _entry. UnfinishedOf returns a bool. AtLeastOf returns {size, onDisk, files, sizeText, onDiskText}, with the texts from the App's FigureText.FormatSize by reflection and the word left to the case. RolledOf returns {size, onDisk}. A root-child lookup matches a list row's Path against GetPath over FirstChild(0)..+ChildCount(0), independently of the tracker's index mapping. TreeMode adds storeUnfinished, storeAtLeast and storeRolled to NodeFields. It adds sizeClipped and onDiskClipped to Rendered, from LayoutInformation.GetLayoutClip against the measured text, because ActualWidth hides the overflow. It adds one 'cell-fit' line per walk: TopLevelRowText.AtLeastSize(1000) measured with a realized SizeText's typeface, size and PixelsPerDip, against that TextBlock's Width. It adds atLeastRealized to the expand line: realized children whose drawn SizeText starts with the word, counted after the timed frame. TopRows adds figures (FiguresOf by reflection), storeUnfinished, storeNotListed and storeAtLeast.
components.key_interactions: TreeMode.cs (NodeFields, Rendered, the expand line) calls these readers. No expected value comes from a row's own properties (lesson #310).

components.name: Window case T-013: the at-least marks
components.responsibility: Run 1 uses New-StoppedTreeFixture (T-010's tree), stops at 'm-mid\', chooses the tree and WALKs it. It is VOID unless $T010Needs holds, at least one listed depth-2 row reads storeUnfinished, and c-prefix reads storeUnfinished false. C1: every walked row with storeUnfinished and not storeNotListed draws `'at least ' + storeAtLeast.sizeText` and the onDisk equivalent, with neither cell clipped. Such rows must exist at depths 0, 1 and 2 and as a file row, and at least one must have storeAtLeast differ from storeRolled. The cell-fit line must show the widest prefixed figure within the cell's Width. C2: for every row drawing 'at least' or 'not read yet', every ancestor up to depth 0 draws 'at least' in both cells. C3: every listed row with storeUnfinished false draws exactly FormatSize of its store figures, with no word; c-prefix, a-empty, b-listed\empty and b-listed\denied must be among them. C4: across the 9 top-row lines, a row's figures carry the word exactly when storeUnfinished && !storeNotListed. A marked folder row reads 'at least X (at least Y on disk) in at least N file(s) and at least M folder(s)', where X and Y equal the depth-1 tree row's drawn cells and N equals storeAtLeast.files. NotRead rows carry no word and keep their '(not read yet)' title. The stopped tree header starts with $StoppedTreeLead and contains the at-least clause. Run 2 scans the same tree to the end (C6): no row property or drawn text contains 'at least', every storeUnfinished is false, and the finished header has no 'at least'.
components.key_interactions: Reuses Invoke-StoppedTreeRun, Invoke-TreeRun, Lines-Of, $T010Needs and New-StoppedTreeFixture. Keeps its own literal $AtLeast = 'at least', as $NotReadYet does. Every folder the WALK opens has at most 1,000 children (lesson #310). The stop target is a prefix with a slow successor (lesson #502).

components.name: Window case T-014: opening a 100k folder with marks in place
components.responsibility: Builds New-BigStopFixture $root 3000, stops at 'm-big\' and expands m-big five times, as T-012's stopped half does. It is VOID unless open 1 reports notListedChildren >= 5,000 and atLeastRealized >= 1. Each open must draw its first rows in under 500 ms with at most 200 rows built. It prints the count of 'at least' rows realized. T-012 is not edited.

components.name: Mutants that remove the marks
components.responsibility: NoTreeAtLeast replaces FolderTreeNode's bound read with null; T-013 must print its C1 and C2 FAIL lines (and the C4 figure-parity line it causes). NoListAtLeast replaces `result?.StoppedTopLevel()` with `result?.TopLevel`; T-013 must FAIL on its C4 line. The build fixes the exact FAIL lines by running each mutant. Both join the ValidateSet and $CaseMutants (the Q-115 roster check) and run under -Mutant All (Q-114).

components.name: Core Facts: the marking read and the words
components.responsibility: A new StoppedTopLevelTests class runs on real %TEMP% trees, stopped through the existing seams: NotListedTests.StopAt for the listing, and the ScanOptions Probe/ProbeBatch/AfterFolder seams UnfinishedTests uses for the size checks. (a) StoppedTopLevel keeps every public property of every row except AtLeast, compared by reflection, Revised and FailedKind included. (b) row.AtLeast equals `Unfinished && !NotListed ? AtLeast(entry) : null` for the entry whose Name equals row.Name. (c) When any row is marked it returns a new object; Completed and Count-0 results return TopLevel itself, and a Count-0 store is not read at all. (d) On a ragged tree (lesson #511), every Unfinished or NotListed entry other than 0 has an Unfinished parent, which is criterion 2's premise. TopLevelRowTextTests gains checks that FiguresOf puts the word before each figure on marked rows from both kinds of stop, and that unmarked rows keep today's text byte-for-byte.
components.key_interactions: Compiles TopLevelRowText.cs as linked source. Uses the stale-hardlink re-stale step of lesson #523 only if a hardlink fixture is added. Every expected value comes from the store's answers.

key_decisions.decision: A figure is qualified exactly when `Unfinished(entry) && !NotListed(entry)`, and the qualified number is ScanStore.AtLeast, never RolledSize or RolledOnDisk. A not-listed row keeps SL-110's 'no figure at all' in the tree and its '(not read yet)' title in the list.
key_decisions.rationale: The SL-112 doc (lines 57-64, 98-100) measured rolled figures above the final ones (64 MiB against 1 MiB final), so 'at least <rolled>' can be false. U-206 (GO) found 0 mismatches in 736,644 real comparisons for 'unmarked means final'. Tree and list share one predicate, so criterion 4's parity follows by construction.

key_decisions.decision: No ancestor walk in the App: each row asks the store about its own entry.
key_decisions.rationale: For a folder, Unfinished folds in NotListedAtOrBelow and the pending run from its first child to the end of its descendants (ScanStore.cs:201-224, 281-311). So under the scanner's depth-first, one-block-per-folder registration, an unfinished or unlisted entry always has an unfinished parent, up to entry 0. That holds only under that order (SL-111 and SL-112 are conditional on it; lesson #510), so a Core Fact on a ragged tree pins it and T-013 walks the ancestors.

key_decisions.decision: Tree rows read the bound lazily on first draw and cache it per row; EnsureChildren gets no new read.
key_decisions.rationale: This follows the existing Size, Name and Note idiom and leaves the measured cold-open build untouched (lesson #170). Only realized rows, about 25, pay for it. The measured worst case over every row of the 100k folder was 29.5 ms (Debug, listing Stop), against the 500 ms bar.

key_decisions.decision: Stopped list rows get their bound from ScanResult.StoppedTopLevel(), which delegates to an internal static TopLevelTracker.WithAtLeast. The row field is a new Core value type, TopLevelAtLeast, not ScanStore.AtLeastFigures.
key_decisions.rationale: The App cannot build a TopLevelRow, because InternalsVisibleTo names only Core.Tests. TopLevelSnapshot.cs may not name ScanStore (allow-list, fitness.yaml:564-586). Restating Revised in a copy is legal only in TopLevelTracker.cs (fitness.yaml:850-859). ScanResult is the sanctioned way to a store. A new snapshot object also gets past ShowFinalTopLevel's reference-equal skip. Moving the read into Scanner.Finish was rejected: it would put the read on the writing thread and in the scanner tier, and add to Stop latency. This is a public Core contract that MainWindow, TopLevelRowText, the hook and Core.Tests read.

key_decisions.decision: Order, share text and bars stay on the listed (rolled) on-disk figures in Core's ChildrenLargestFirst order, and the tree header says 'by space on disk as listed'.
key_decisions.rationale: After a Stop in the listing the watermark is 0 (Scanner.cs:583), so ranking by AtLeast would put almost every row at 'at least 0 bytes' (fact 1: 217,336 of about 488,000 folders) and would change Core's sort. Bars by listed size are what still tells the person which folder is big, which is the value U-193 bet on. Q-277 keeps the stopped tree's bars.

key_decisions.decision: No file-count column in the tree. The file count, with the folder and could-not-be-read counts, is marked where it is drawn: on the stopped list's figures line.
key_decisions.rationale: Tree rows have no count column (MainWindow.xaml:419-489). One would cost about 100 DIP more on top of the 44 the widening already takes from Name. Criterion 1's 'each figure on its row' is read as the figures a row draws. Whether that reading is right is an open question; if not, a count column is a separate slice.

key_decisions.decision: Size and On disk columns go from 80 to 102 DIP in both headings and cells. T-013 checks the widest prefixed figure directly against the cell width, and reads the layout clip of every drawn figure.
key_decisions.rationale: The spike was a no-go at 80: 'at least 1,000 bytes' is 101.26 DIP and clips to 'at least 1,000 b'. At 102 it is unclipped with 0.74 DIP to spare. After a listing Stop the fixture only ever draws 'at least 0 bytes', so a data-driven check alone could not catch a revert. ActualWidth hides the overflow, so the checks read the clip or the slot.

key_decisions.decision: Reword only the size clause of the two stopped list headers, keep the tree header's lead, and append one at-least clause to the tree header. Update the two pinned constants $StoppedListHeader and $StoppedSizingHeader in WindowCases.ps1. That is the one deliberate departure from criterion 6's 'existing cases pass unchanged': no check logic changes, only the two expected strings.
key_decisions.rationale: The shipped headers say every row, 'unmarked ones included, may be off'. Once rows carry marks, that contradicts the slice's goal ('any figure without a mark is final') and U-206's measurement. 'Are short' is not reintroduced, so open questions Q-288/Q-289 are left as they are. The header text stays in one function each, so the owner's answer there is a one-place edit. There is no separate size-check arm in the tree header: the one clause is true after either kind of Stop. SC-404's intent is folded in rather than built as a separate arm.

key_decisions.decision: Criterion 5 gets a new case, T-014, and criteria 1-4 and 6 get a new T-013. T-010, T-011 and T-012 keep their code; only the two header constants move.
key_decisions.rationale: The engine's limit is per command (Q-222, 120 s). A stopped-only 100k case is about 50-60 s, against T-012's 81 s for both halves. With the marks, T-010's m-mid still draws a non-empty onDisk, and a-empty, b-listed\empty and T-011's j-before are listed and empty, so they stay final and still read '0 bytes'.

key_decisions.decision: Declare two architecture rules: the at-least figure is never the rolled or listing figure, and the at-least word is composed only in TopLevelRowText.
key_decisions.rationale: The first is the measured defect class from SL-112 (rolled above final), and nothing static guards it. The second keeps AtLeastSize the only composer, mirroring SL-110's 'unread word written once' rule. Cost: a fitness.yaml append brings the rules harness and RuleCases C-001/C-003 into build, review and validate, and shifts their settled counts (lessons #486, #212).

proposals.note: Selected as the core. Redesigned at three seams the tree refutes. (1) WithAtLeast in TopLevelSnapshot.cs names ScanStore, which the 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore' allow-list forbids: the read moves to TopLevelTracker.cs behind ScanResult.StoppedTopLevel(), and the row field becomes TopLevelAtLeast. (2) The row copy restates Revised, which the Revised-setter rule allows only in TopLevelTracker.cs: the copy lives there. (3) T-012 is not extended: a new T-014 fits the per-command limit. Also trimmed: the headers stay in MainWindow, there is no separate size-check tree arm, and the clip check measures the widest figure explicitly because the fixture's at-least figures are all 0. The proposal's claim that 'at least 0 bytes' already overflows 80 DIP is not relied on; nothing measured it.

payload.coherence_check: There was one proposal, so there is no composition to check: nothing in this design has yet survived a disagreement, and the reviewer is the first to argue with it. What I checked instead is that the proposal holds together against the rules and code already in the tree. Three of its seams did not. (a) TopLevelSnapshot.WithAtLeast(ScanStore) and a `ScanStore.AtLeastFigures?` property would put the type name into src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevelSnapshot.cs, which is not on the allow-list of 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends' (fitness.yaml:579-586). (b) A row copy outside TopLevelTracker.cs that keeps Revised trips 'only the tracker sets a top-level row's Revised flag' (fitness.yaml:850-859), and a copy that drops Revised loses the '(revised)' mark. (c) Extending T-012 contradicts criterion 6 for no reason, since the limit is per command. The seam was redesigned: the store is read and the rows rebuilt in TopLevelTracker.cs, which is allowed both. ScanResult (also allowed) is the public way in. TopLevelSnapshot.cs gains only a value type, an init property and an internal copy. Invariants checked across the pieces kept: both surfaces read the same returned store, after Scan has returned, on the UI thread, with one predicate (Unfinished && !NotListed), so tree and list cannot disagree on a mark (criterion 4) and neither reads mid-scan (lesson #522). The ordering, share and bars stay on listed figures in both, and the header says so. The Count-0 guard is in StoppedTopLevel; the tree is already guarded by OffersStoppedTree (lesson #517). The error contract is fail-loud: an impossible row/child mismatch throws rather than leaving rows unmarked, because an unmarked row would claim to be final. Two answered questions bear on it and are reported, not built around. Q-111 (a person's answer) said 'no per-row marks after Cancel', and this slice's definition of done, agreed later by a model, adds them, as SL-110 already did with 'not read yet'. Q-111's header sentence ('other rows' figures may be off') becomes false for unmarked rows against U-206's measurement once marks exist. Both are open questions; the design proceeds on the definition of done and changes only header text, a one-place edit. Lesson #520 already treats Q-111's header text as superseded. Q-276 is respected (NotRead rows keep their line), and Q-288/Q-289 are not decided ('are short' is not reintroduced). No outside defect is worked around, so no KnownWorkarounds entry applies. This slice touches MainWindow*, so the standing network-pass debt holds: Cancel on a stalled share is unmeasured and this slice claims no cancel-safety (lesson #136). T-003 is red on this display for a known reason (Q-279), so the timing evidence is T-014 and T-012. The architecture rules constrain what may be written, not who may depend on whom: the dependency seams this design relies on are already enforced by existing rules (the App store rule, the Core ScanStore allow-list, the Revised setter rule, HasFigures).

contracts.name: ScanResult.StoppedTopLevel() -> TopLevelSnapshot?
contracts.error_cases: Returns TopLevel unchanged, with no store read beyond Count, when Status != Cancelled, TopLevel is null, !TopLevel.Final, TopLevel.Completed, or Store.Count == 0. Throws InvalidOperationException when TopLevel.Rows.Count != Store.ChildCount(0); the tracker's seeding makes that unreachable, and it fails loudly rather than leaving rows unmarked that would read as final.
contracts.notes: Valid only on a returned result. A ScanResult reaches a caller only after Scan returns, and the size-check watermark is written in Finish, so the reads are exact (ScanStore.cs remarks; lesson #522). The cost is about one pass over the pending range: U-205 measured 54.7-71.3 ms for the read of every folder at 5M, and the root's children read less than that.

contracts.name: TopLevelTracker.WithAtLeast(TopLevelSnapshot final, ScanStore store) (internal static)
contracts.notes: Row i is entry store.FirstChild(0)+i. A row is rebuilt only when its entry is Unfinished and not NotListed, keeping every constructor field plus Revised and FailedKind and setting AtLeast. It returns final.WithRows(rows) when any row was rebuilt, else final. It is the only code that sets TopLevelRow.AtLeast.

contracts.name: TopLevelRow.AtLeast : TopLevelAtLeast? and TopLevelAtLeast(long Bytes, long OnDisk, long Files)
contracts.notes: Init-only. It is non-null exactly when the store reports the row's entry Unfinished and not NotListed, with the value of ScanStore.AtLeast. It is null on every snapshot the scanner publishes and on links, NotRead rows and final rows. Bytes, OnDisk, Files and Folders are unchanged listing figures.

contracts.name: TopLevelSnapshot.WithRows(TopLevelRow[] rows) (internal)
contracts.notes: A new snapshot with the given rows (copied and wrapped read-only, as the constructor does) and the same Root, Sequence, Final, Completed, Bytes, OnDisk, Files, Folders and StoppedInSizeChecks.

contracts.name: Tree row figure cells (SizeText, OnDiskText)
contracts.notes: '' when HasFigures is false (closed session or not-listed row). TopLevelRowText.AtLeastSize(AtLeast.Size / .OnDisk) when the entry is Unfinished. Otherwise FormatSize(RolledSize / OnDisk), exactly as today. Share, bar, order and Note are unchanged. The cells are 102 DIP wide.

contracts.name: Stopped list figures line (TopLevelRowText.FiguresOf)
contracts.notes: A marked folder row reads 'at least <size> (at least <on disk> on disk) in at least <N files> and at least <M folders>[; at least <K folders> inside could not be read (in full)]'. A marked file row reads 'at least <size> (at least <on disk> on disk)'. Rows without AtLeast keep today's exact text (Q-276 open for NotRead). Every figure gets its word through AtLeastSize, and the counts through AtLeastWord in the same file.

contracts.name: Stopped headers (MainWindow ListHeader, StoppedTreeHeader)
contracts.notes: The listing-Stop and size-check-Stop list arms say marked figures are all that is certain and a row with no mark is final. The tree header keeps the lead 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before.', then says figures marked at least are all that is certain, a figure with no mark is final, and the order is by space on disk as listed. The running and completed headers are unchanged. The words come from TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet and AtLeastWord.

contracts.name: Hook lines: tree-row, cell-fit, expand, top-row additions
contracts.notes: tree-row: storeUnfinished (bool?), storeAtLeast {size,onDisk,files,sizeText,onDiskText}, storeRolled {size,onDisk}, rendered.sizeClipped and rendered.onDiskClipped. cell-fit (once per walk): {widestText, widestWidth, cellWidth}. expand: atLeastRealized. top-row: figures, storeUnfinished, storeNotListed and storeAtLeast for the root child whose GetPath equals the row's Path. Every store value is read from LastResult.Store and the row's entry, never from a row property.

contracts.name: WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-013 | T-014; WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant NoTreeAtLeast | NoListAtLeast | All
contracts.error_cases: T-013 and T-014 are VOID, never PASS, after 3 launches without the shape they need. A mutant whose Find stops matching exactly once fails the mutant run instead of running the real app.
contracts.notes: At validate: the full Core suite; WindowCases T-013, T-014, L-001, L-004, T-010, T-011 and T-012, each its own command under the 120 s limit; and WindowMutants -Mutant All (Q-114), which validate runs as a whole outside the case matrix, about 7-9 min with the two new mutants.

cases.behaviour: mark an unfinished folder in the stopped tree
cases.shape: a listed folder with folders below it that were never listed (m-mid at depth 1, and the root at depth 0)
cases.why: Unfinished's NotListedAtOrBelow arm: the folder's own mark is clear and only its last-subfolder chain reaches an unlisted folder. T-010 today asserts m-mid has a figure and no note, so the word must sit inside the figure text and not in Note.

cases.behaviour: mark an unfinished folder in the stopped tree
cases.shape: a folder whose whole subtree was listed but whose files' own sizes were never checked (b-listed, b-listed\full, a listed m-mid\dNNN), where the bound (0) differs from the rolled figure (about 212 KiB for b-listed)
cases.why: Unfinished's PendingRun arm, and the one shape where 'at least <rolled>' and 'at least <AtLeast>' draw different text. T-013 asserts drawn == storeAtLeast and != storeRolled on at least one row, so drawing the rolled figure fails (SL-112 doc 57-64).

cases.behaviour: mark an unfinished file in the stopped tree
cases.shape: a file row whose size check is pending (b-listed\b1.bin after a Stop in the listing)
cases.why: The file arm of Unfinished and AtLeast returns (0, 0, 1), a different branch from the folder run. The file must draw 'at least 0 bytes', not its listed 4 KiB.

cases.behaviour: draw an 'at least' figure in full
cases.shape: the widest text the formatter can write, prefixed: 'at least 1,000 bytes' (101.26 DIP at this PC's font and DPI)
cases.why: The spike's no-go: at Width 80 the cell clips to 'at least 1,000 b', and ActualWidth hides it. After a Stop in the listing every bound is 0, so the fixture never draws the widest figure. The hook measures it against the cell's Width, and T-013 also reads the layout clip of every drawn figure.

cases.behaviour: mark every ancestor up to the root
cases.shape: an unread folder at depth 2 under a listed depth-1 folder, and unread folders at depth 1 (p00-p04), on a tree of uneven depth
cases.why: The App does no walk. It relies on Unfinished folding in descendants under depth-first, one-block registration (SL-111 conditional, lesson #510; queue order gives wrong answers). The window walks ancestors on T-010's tree, and the Core Fact checks parent monotonicity over many stops on a ragged tree (lesson #511).
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-013 ; pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~StoppedTopLevelTests"

cases.shape: a listed folder with 5,000 listed subfolders and no file anywhere below it (c-prefix), beside listed empty folders (a-empty, b-listed\empty) and a folder whose open was refused (b-listed\denied)
cases.why: PendingRun is non-empty for c-prefix but holds no entry that checks its own size, so Unfinished is false. That is the branch where a careless 'has descendants' test would over-mark. Criterion 3 is vacuous unless such a row is present.

cases.behaviour: mark the stopped list's rows like the tree's
cases.shape: one list holding a Done row with pending size checks (b-listed), a stopped-partway row (m-mid), not-read rows (p00-p04) and Done final rows (a-empty, c-prefix)
cases.why: The list's State does not decide the mark: a Done row can be unfinished, and a NotRead row keeps its title mark and today's figures (Q-276 open). Marked figures must equal the depth-1 tree cells, and N files must equal the store's count.

cases.behaviour: copy the final snapshot with the store's bounds
cases.shape: a row carrying fields the constructor does not take (Revised after a correction, FailedKind on an unreadable row), in stores stopped in the listing and in the size checks
cases.why: The tracker rebuilds the row field by field. A field forgotten in the copy silently drops '(revised)' or the unreadable wording on the ending's list. The Fact compares every public property except AtLeast by reflection, and checks FiguresOf's words on marked rows from both kinds of stop.

cases.behaviour: show the marked list at the ending
cases.shape: a tick already drew the final, unmarked snapshot before the ending ran
cases.why: ShowFinalTopLevel skips a snapshot reference-equal to the one shown (MainWindow.xaml.cs:370). StoppedTopLevel must return a new object whenever any row is marked, or the list keeps its unmarked rows. A window case cannot force the tick timing, so the Core Fact pins the new-object contract.

cases.behaviour: end a stopped scan whose root was never listed
cases.shape: the Stop lands in calls 1-2: the store holds 0 entries and TopLevel is null
cases.why: ScanStore.At throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException at Count 0 (lesson #517). StoppedTopLevel must return TopLevel without reading the store. NotListedTests.StopAt with call 1 produces the shape.

cases.behaviour: open a 100k-child folder in a stopped tree with marks drawn
cases.shape: m-big's 100,000 children after a Stop under it, with at least one 'at least' row in the first screenful and at least 5,000 rows unread
cases.why: Criterion 5. Each realized row's bound is read on first draw, inside the timed frame. The measured worst case over all 100k rows is 29.5 ms (Debug), but no window run has drawn marks. The case is void unless the marks are realized.

cases.behaviour: show nothing as 'at least' after a scan that ran to the end
cases.shape: the same tree scanned to completion, plus every existing stopped-ending case, with only the two list-header constants changed
cases.why: PendingRun is false once the watermark equals Count, so Unfinished is false everywhere. Run 2 proves no text carries the word. L-001, L-004, T-010, T-011 and T-012 prove the existing assertions still hold with marks in place: m-mid non-empty, the empty folders '0 bytes', the cut m-big with no figure, and the 100k opens.
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-013 ; then each of -Case L-001, -Case L-004, -Case T-010, -Case T-011, -Case T-012 with the same command

cases.behaviour: prove the window checks catch missing marks
cases.shape: the tree's bound read replaced by null (NoTreeAtLeast); the ending's StoppedTopLevel call replaced by result?.TopLevel (NoListAtLeast)
cases.why: A green T-013 is only evidence if removing each mark turns its own lines red (Q-114, SC-393). Each mutant must print exactly the expected FAIL lines, so a check that cannot fail is caught.
cases.check: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant NoTreeAtLeast ; pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant NoListAtLeast

cases.behaviour: mark the stopped tree after a Stop in the size checks
cases.shape: every folder listed, and Stop cancelled a batch of the size checks, with the tree chosen
cases.why: Judged not worth a window case. The tree uses the same predicate as the listing-Stop case. Which entries are unfinished at a size-check Stop is the store's answer, already proved by SL-112 (U-205: 0 violations in 2,588 real Stops). The list's words for this Stop are covered by the Core Fact and its header by L-004. A window case would need a new hook stop trigger inside the size checks.

architecture_rules.name: an 'at least' figure is never the rolled or listing figure
architecture_rules.because: Rolled and listing figures can sit above the final ones (SL-112 doc 57-64: 64 MiB shown against 1 MiB final; 20,998 unfinished folders above the reference), so 'at least <rolled>' is a false statement on screen. The only true number is ScanStore.AtLeast, carried as the tree row's Bound or the list row's AtLeast. Correct code passes b.Size / a.Bytes and stays quiet; the patterns fire on the row's own rolled Size or OnDisk, the list row's Bytes or OnDisk, or a RolledSize/RolledOnDisk call.

architecture_rules.name: the at-least word is composed only in TopLevelRowText
architecture_rules.because: The tree and the list must word a lower bound identically (criterion 4), and every bound must go through AtLeastSize, which the first rule guards. A second literal copy, or a figure built by hand from AtLeastWord and FormatSize, is how the surfaces drift apart and how a rolled figure gets the word past the first rule. The App holds no 'at least' string today (survey grep: comments only).

code_claims.claim: HasFigures is `_session.Store is not null && !_notListed`, and OnDiskText, SizeText, ShareText and ShareShown all read it.
Size reads store.RolledSize(_entry) each time it is read, and OnDisk is the rolled on-disk figure passed in at construction.
EnsureChildren builds a folder's rows once from ChildrenLargestFirst, reading ChildCount and NotListed per child, and records LastSortMs and LastBuildMs on the session.

For a file Unfinished is its pending size check; for any other non-folder it is false; for a folder it is true when NotListedAtOrBelow is true or an entry that checks its own size lies in its pending run.

For a folder AtLeast returns the rolled size and on-disk less the listed Size and OnDisk of every own-size-checked entry in its pending run, with FilesBelow as the count; for a pending file it returns (0, 0, 1).
AtLeastFigures is a public readonly record struct (long Size, long OnDisk, int Files) nested in ScanStore, so naming it names ScanStore.
PendingRun returns false when the folder has no children or the size-check watermark is at or past Count, so a Completed store marks nothing.
NotListedAtOrBelow follows only each folder's last subfolder, and its remarks say it is exact only for depth-first registration with one SetChildren per whole block.
ChecksOwnSize is true for a file that is neither a hardlink duplicate nor cloud-only, so a folder holding only folders has no pending entry.
The tracker seeds row i of its snapshots as store entry _first + i, the root's first child.
TopLevelRow has an internal nine-argument constructor and init-only Revised and FailedKind, and its Bytes and OnDisk are the tracker's credited listing figures.
StoppedInSizeChecks is an init property of the final snapshot, true only for a Stop that cancelled a size-check batch.
ScanResult carries a required ScanStore Store and the final TopLevel snapshot, which is null only when the root's listing never committed.
Core grants InternalsVisibleTo only to FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, so the App cannot construct a TopLevelRow.
NotReadYet is the single constant for the unread word, used by TitleOf, the tree's Note and the stopped headers.
FiguresOf writes '<size> (<on disk> on disk)' and, for a folder, the file and folder counts and the unreadable clause, all from the row's own fields with no qualifier.
ShowFinalTopLevel clears the list for null and otherwise redraws only when the final snapshot is not reference-equal to the one already shown.
ListHeader has three arms (running, StoppedInSizeChecks, Stop in the listing), and both stopped arms say rows may be off.
StoppedTreeHeader takes only the root and returns the NotReadYet lead followed by 'Largest first, by space on disk, of what was read in {root}'.
ShowTopLevel sorts a copy of the rows, sets the header from ListHeader, swaps ItemsSource, and reselects the row with the same Path.
LastResult is set at the top of ShowOutcome, which runs after the ending has already called ShowFinalTopLevel with result?.TopLevel.
The tree's Size and On disk headings and their SizeText and OnDiskText cells are fixed at Width 80.
NotListedOf reads the store's NotListed for a row's _entry through the window's LastResult on each call, independently of the row's properties.
TopRows logs only each list row's name, path, state and TitleOf title, with no figures and no store answer.
$StoppedListHeader and $StoppedSizingHeader pin the exact stopped list headers, which L-001, L-004 and T-010 compare against.
CheckStoppedRows asserts that m-mid has note '' and a non-empty onDisk, and that a-empty and b-listed\empty draw '0 bytes' with no note.
New-BigStopFixture builds m-big from 90,000 empty files and 10,000 one-byte folders, with j-before an empty folder listed before it.
Each case mutant gives a File, a Find regex that must match exactly once, a Replace, a Case, and the exact FAIL lines the case must print.

decidable_disagreements.question: Does the ending's StoppedTopLevel read (Unfinished + AtLeast for every root child, about one pass over the pending range) stay well within one UI frame budget on a 5M-entry store stopped in the listing?
decidable_disagreements.positions: This design puts it on the UI thread at the ending. U-205 measured the read of every folder at 5M at 54.7-71.3 ms, and SL-112 measured the read form at <= 12 ms for one folder at 5M, so the root's children should cost well under 100 ms. Nothing has measured it inside the App. If it takes hundreds of ms, the read moves into Scanner.Finish on the writing thread after the watermark is written: a component boundary and risk-tier change.

taste_disagreements: Where the headers live: the proposal moves ListHeader and StoppedTreeHeader into TopLevelRowText so Core.Tests can pin every arm. This design leaves them in MainWindow (smaller diff) and relies on L-001/L-004/T-010 for the list headers and T-013 for the tree clause.

Tree header after a Stop in the size checks: the proposal adds a separate arm without the 'Not read yet' lead (SC-404). This design appends one at-least clause, true after both kinds of Stop, and keeps the lead for both (unchanged from today).

Criterion 5's case: the proposal extends T-012 with a void rule. This design adds T-014 and leaves T-012 byte-for-byte, at the cost of building the 100k fixture a second time (about 30 s) at validate.

Whether to declare any fitness rule: the proposal declares none, to avoid the rules-harness and RuleCases count churn (lesson #486). This design declares two narrow ones over the measured rolled-above-final trap. Dropping them leaves T-013's drawn-equals-bound check as the only guard.
open_questions: Criterion 6 says the existing window cases pass unchanged, but the two stopped list headers they pin ($StoppedListHeader, $StoppedSizingHeader, used by L-001, L-004 and T-010) say every row, unmarked ones included, may be off. That is false once rows carry marks (U-206: unmarked is final). This design rewords the size clause and updates only those two expected strings. Is that acceptable, or must the shipped headers stay and the rewording go to a later slice?

Q-111 (answered by a person) said 'no per-row marks after Cancel', and its header sentence says other rows' figures may be off. This slice's definition of done, agreed later by a model, adds per-row 'at least' marks after Stop, as SL-110 already added 'not read yet'. Does the epic supersede Q-111 on both points?

After a Stop in the listing almost every figure reads 'at least 0 bytes' (fact 1: 217,336 of about 488,000 folders), because no file's own size was read. Ranking and bars stay on listed sizes. Is the bound alone the intended display, or should the listed figure also be shown beside it (a follow-up slice)?

Criterion 1 names file count among the figures to mark, but tree rows have no file-count column. This design marks the count where it is drawn, on the stopped list's figures line. Does 'each figure on its row' mean that, or does the tree need a file-count column (about 100 DIP more, a layout slice)?

cross_domain_transfer.source_domain: Search engines and Elasticsearch result counts
cross_domain_transfer.pattern: Put the figure's relation on the figure itself: Elasticsearch's hits.total carries 'eq' or 'gte' beside the value, rather than a page-level 'counts may be approximate'. Here that is a per-cell 'at least' on lower bounds, with an unqualified cell guaranteed final, instead of the header-only 'any row may be off' caveat shipped in SL-112.
cross_domain_transfer.rationale: Selected in part. The per-figure qualifier and the 'unqualified means exact' promise are this design's core. The ranking stays on a third quantity (the listed figure), which search counts have no analogue for, so the header says what the order is by. It holds only if 'gte' is a true lower bound and 'eq' is truly exact.

invariants.precondition: The shown 'at least' value is a true lower bound on what an uninterrupted scan of the unchanged tree gives.
invariants.evidence: SL-112 at-least forms measured exact (GO: 0 mismatches over 737k real and 81k engineered comparisons). The design shows ScanStore.AtLeast, never the rolled figure, and the first architecture rule fences the rolled figure out.
U-206 GO: 0 mismatches in 736,644 real comparisons for folders whose subtree was listed and sized before Stop. U-205 GO: 0 violations in 2,588 real Stops.

invariants.precondition: The qualifier propagates to every ancestor up to the root.
invariants.evidence: Holds only under depth-first, one-SetChildren-per-block registration (SL-111 conditional; lesson #510). Pinned by the Core Fact's parent-monotonicity check on a ragged tree and by T-013's ancestor walk.

invariants.precondition: Reads happen only on a store that nothing writes any more.
invariants.evidence: StoppedTopLevel is reachable only through a ScanResult, which a caller gets after Scan returns. Tree rows read through FolderTreeSession, which holds only a returned store (lesson #522).

prior_art.pattern: A count that is only a lower bound is returned with relation 'gte' and an exact one with 'eq'; consumers read the relation on each value instead of trusting a global caveat.
Result counts shown as 'N+' or 'about N' when not exhaustive, with the qualifier on the number itself.
prior_art.where: Common search UIs (for example GitHub code search result counts)

prior_art.pattern: Folder sizes that keep growing during a calculation are shown with no qualifier, so a partial figure reads as final: the failure the per-cell mark avoids.
